Based on the provided image of the Kozy Care admin console at 1280px:

(a) **Yes.** The navy left sidebar contains all the specified menu items: Dashboard, Notifications, Orders, Verify Payments, Customers, Finances, Reviews, Feedback, Staff, Settings, and Help.
(b) **Yes.** There is a green "Live" indicator with the text "list update automatically. No refresh needed." located at the bottom of the sidebar.
(c) **No.** There is no stray duplicate mobile navigation at the top of the content area; only a search bar and user profile header are present above the main content.
(d) **Yes.** The overall layout is correct for a desktop admin console, featuring a fixed-width sidebar on the left and a responsive main content area displaying dashboard metrics and lists.
